answer_1.quote: Driven by recent advancements in LLMs' reasoning capabilities, a trend has developed in improving translation quality through a human-like decomposition-translation-refinement paradigm.

answer_2.quote: Evaluation. Following best practice , we use both reference-based and reference-free neural metrics, using COMET DA 22 and COMETKiwi-XL DA 23, respectively. We also report results in XCOMET-XL and MetricX-23-XL
